properties.description: Conduct a needs-analysis session with the user on making the UI editor's Visual view useful for existing repository components. Start from the selected ScrollArea source and the current message requiring an exported uiDefinition. Clarify the required inspection, rendering, composition, public configuration, source editing and saving behavior; what support a component must supply; and the boundary between visual editing and code. Do not assume an exported uiDefinition or the current seven-control registry is the desired solution. Ask one question at a time and preserve questions and answers verbatim in a dedicated Markdown transcript. Agree scope and unresolved questions before proposing implementation.
properties.title: Analyze what existing components need to work in Visual
